description: This file defines the `MerchantStore` entity class in a Java-based e-commerce application, modeling store details and its relationships with other entities such as Country, Zone, Language, and Currency.

classes.name: MerchantStore
classes.description: Entity class representing a merchant's store with various attributes such as name, contact details, location, currency, language, and store-specific configurations.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the merchant store.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the merchant store.

methods.name: getStorename
methods.description: Returns the name of the store.

methods.name: setStorename
methods.description: Sets the name of the store.

methods.name: getStorephone
methods.description: Returns the phone number of the store.

methods.name: setStorephone
methods.description: Sets the phone number of the store.

methods.name: getStoreaddress
methods.description: Returns the address of the store.

methods.name: setStoreaddress
methods.description: Sets the address of the store.

methods.name: getStorecity
methods.description: Returns the city where the store is located.

methods.name: setStorecity
methods.description: Sets the city where the store is located.

methods.name: getStorepostalcode
methods.description: Returns the postal code of the store.

methods.name: setStorepostalcode
methods.description: Sets the postal code of the store.

methods.name: getCountry
methods.description: Returns the Country object associated with the store.

methods.name: setCountry
methods.description: Sets the Country object for the store.

methods.name: getZone
methods.description: Returns the Zone object associated with the store.

methods.name: setZone
methods.description: Sets the Zone object for the store.

methods.name: getStorestateprovince
methods.description: Returns the state or province of the store.

methods.name: setStorestateprovince
methods.description: Sets the state or province of the store.

methods.name: getWeightunitcode
methods.description: Returns the weight measurement unit code.

methods.name: setWeightunitcode
methods.description: Sets the weight measurement unit code.

methods.name: getSeizeunitcode
methods.description: Returns the size unit code.

methods.name: setSeizeunitcode
methods.description: Sets the size unit code.

methods.name: getInBusinessSince
methods.description: Returns the date when the store started business, cloned to avoid mutability.

methods.name: setInBusinessSince
methods.description: Sets the date when the store started business.

methods.name: getDefaultLanguage
methods.description: Returns the default Language object for the store.

methods.name: setDefaultLanguage
methods.description: Sets the default Language for the store.

methods.name: getLanguages
methods.description: Returns the list of Language objects associated with the store.

methods.name: setLanguages
methods.description: Sets the list of languages for the store.

methods.name: isUseCache
methods.description: Indicates whether caching is enabled for store data.

methods.name: setUseCache
methods.description: Enables or disables caching for store data.

methods.name: getStoreLogo
methods.description: Returns the store's logo filename or path.

methods.name: setStoreLogo
methods.description: Sets the store's logo filename or path.

methods.name: getStoreTemplate
methods.description: Returns the template used for store pages.

methods.name: setStoreTemplate
methods.description: Sets the template used for store pages.

methods.name: getInvoiceTemplate
methods.description: Returns the invoice template used.

methods.name: setInvoiceTemplate
methods.description: Sets the invoice template.

methods.name: getDomainName
methods.description: Returns the store's domain name.

methods.name: setDomainName
methods.description: Sets the store's domain name.

methods.name: getContinueshoppingurl
methods.description: Returns the URL for continuing shopping.

methods.name: setContinueshoppingurl
methods.description: Sets the URL for continuing shopping.

methods.name: getStoreEmailAddress
methods.description: Returns the store's email address.

methods.name: setStoreEmailAddress
methods.description: Sets the store's email address.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the store's code.

methods.name: setCode
methods.description: Sets the store's code.

methods.name: getDateBusinessSince
methods.description: Returns the date as a string when the store has been in business.

methods.name: setDateBusinessSince
methods.description: Sets the business start date as a string.

methods.name: getCurrencyFormatNational
methods.description: Indicates whether the currency format is national.

methods.name: setCurrencyFormatNational
methods.description: Sets whether to use national currency formatting.
